summary: The place toasts show: a stack in a corner of the window, above everything else.

placement.description: The corner of the window the stack sits in.

root.note: A stack fixed to a corner of the window, in the top layer while it holds an open toast. It paints nothing itself.

guidance.text: It is named Notifications unless the author wrote aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Add a toast with `open` to the toaster to show it; the newest is nearest the corner.

notYet: A limit on how many toasts show at once.
